implemented_requirements.evidence: Board._build() returns a list of 24 Space objects including GoSpace, PropertySpace, ChanceSpace, TaxSpace, JailSpace, FreeParkingSpace, GoToJailSpace.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Dice rolling mechanics (pair of dice, total, doubles detection)
implemented_requirements.evidence: class Dice in dice.py with roll(), total property and is_doubles property.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player model with money, position, jail status, property list, net worth
implemented_requirements.evidence: class Player in player.py defines money, position, in_jail, properties, net_worth, receive(), pay(), etc.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Chance deck with a set of simplified cards
implemented_requirements.evidence: class ChanceDeck in chance.py builds a list of ChanceCard objects and provides draw().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Utility functions for prompting and formatting
implemented_requirements.evidence: utils.py defines ask_yes_no, ask_int, format_money, divider, press_enter.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board display showing space details and player tokens
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.display(self, players) prints each space with owner info and token markers.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game setup prompting for number of players
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.setup() calls ask_int("How many players (2-4)? ", minimum=2, maximum=4).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Property purchase logic (prompt player, transfer ownership, deduct money)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code in the provided files implements buying a PropertySpace.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Rent collection when landing on owned property
implemented_requirements.evidence: No implementation of rent payment is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Chance card effects applied during play
implemented_requirements.evidence: ChanceDeck exists but there is no code that draws a card or applies its effect.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Jail rules (going to jail, paying fine, using Get Out of Jail Free)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player methods for jail exist, but Game never invokes them.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Free Parking pot accumulation and payout
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.free_parking_pot is defined but never modified or awarded.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Main game loop handling turns, dice rolls, movement, win detection
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game class lacks a run() method; Game.setup() is incomplete (ends with ellipsis).

critical_issues: Game.setup() is incomplete and ends with an ellipsis, indicating missing player creation logic.
No Game.run() or turn‑handling method is defined, so the program cannot be executed.
Core gameplay mechanics (buying properties, paying rent, handling chance cards, jail, free parking) are absent.
Property ownership linking between PropertySpace.owner and Player.properties is never performed.
The free_parking_pot variable is never updated or paid out.
judge.summary: The repository contains the data structures (board, dice, player, chance deck) and some utility helpers, but the core game engine is missing. The Game class is incomplete, lacking a run loop, property purchase, rent collection, chance handling, jail enforcement, and free parking logic. Consequently, the implementation does not satisfy the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to run as a functional Monopoly Go! game.
